platform: Apple M1, arm64, 8 physical/logical cores, 8GiB memory; both retained applications measured now on the same machine

method.scope: Warm-cache whole fresh-process implementations, not kernel timing, cold-cache timing, isolated capability overhead or a language ranking.
method.observer: Identical Node synchronous child observation and regular-file stdout/stderr capture for both. Descriptors open before timing; spawn through child completion is timed, including secured report generation. No rebuilding, hashing, validation or other local work while a measured child runs.
method.order: Eight paired rounds, alternating legacy/canonical and canonical/legacy: four of each order. One separate full-input correctness/warmup process per variant precedes all retained samples.
method.series_boundary: This is a new common-observer comparison, not extra samples for the earlier canonical Rust 1ms-observer or historical pipe-capture series. Do not splice the series or attribute their duration difference solely to observer overhead.

legacy.configuration: The original selected historical-fast executable, packed/narrow counters, standard map, four partitions; original environment authenticated against the retained v321 receipt. No rebuild or source substitution.

canonical.safety: All nine actual secured reports exactly equal the original full-input qualification report. Complete finite policy, real owners, granted stdin/stdout operations, cumulative accounts and one atomic host round are unchanged; previously disclosed OS/Rust argv and stdin provider-cache account exclusions remain.

comparison.median_definition: Arithmetic mean of the two middle durations for eight samples.
comparison.interpretation: The secured canonical application is about 2.4% faster at the medians and faster in all eight pairs. This meets the selected legacy speed target for this exact input and machine; it is not proof of a universal speedup or an optimization ceiling.

verification.physical_audit: v965 rehashes both retained binaries, input/oracle/launch, all output/error/report files and both provenance receipts; checks identical secured reports/policy, exact case/sample ordering, balanced pairs and recomputed medians/ratios.
verification.supervision: v964 exited 0 with owned cleanup complete in 17.98925s; this total includes qualification and is not an individual timing.
verification.preservation: Original measurements remain unchanged. The new driver, actual outputs/reports and measurement remain in tmp/pr-stack-evidence/paired-legacy-line-count-full125m-v964 with supervisor and independent audit v965.
